Prof. Kim Jin-woo's Team Blocks Prox1 Protein Inhibiting Retinal Regeneration
A research team of the Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology (KAIST) has developed a technology that can treat damaged vision by regenerating the retina. The image depicts the mechanism of inducing retinal regeneration by inhibiting the movement of PROX1. (Photo courtesy of KAIST)
A research team of the Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology (KAIST) has developed the world's first retinal disease treatment that can restore damaged vision.
KAIST announced on March 30 that Prof. Kim Jin-woo's team from the Department of Biological Sciences has developed a treatment method that can restore vision through retinal nerve regeneration.
The team successfully induced neural regeneration and vision recovery in retinal tissue by administering a substance that blocks the "Prox1" protein, which inhibits retinal regeneration, into the eyes of disease model mice. The effects lasted for more than six months.
This is the first case in the world to induce long-term neural regeneration in mammalian retinas and is expected to bring hope to patients with degenerative retinal diseases, for which no treatment currently exists.
There is currently no treatment to restore the retina and vision of patients with damage.
Research on ectothermic animals like fish, which have active retinal regeneration, shows that fish have the ability to generate new nerve cells by dedifferentiating Müller glia cells in the retina into neural progenitor cells when retinal damage occurs. However, in mammals like humans, this function is lost, resulting in permanent damage as retinal regeneration does not occur.
In this study, Prof. Kim's team identified the Prox1 protein as a factor that inhibits the dedifferentiation of mammalian Müller glia cells. Prox1 is a protein generated in the nerve cells of neural tissues such as the retina, hippocampus, and spinal cord, which suppresses the division of neural stem cells and induces differentiation into nerve cells.
The research team discovered that the Prox1 protein accumulates in the Müller glia of damaged mouse retinas but not in the Müller glia of fish, where regeneration is active.
They also identified that the Prox1 in Müller glia is not internally generated but is secreted by surrounding nerve cells that fail to degrade it, which is then taken up by Müller glia.
The research team developed a method to restore the neural regeneration ability of Müller glia by removing Prox1 secreted from nerve cells externally before it reaches Müller glia.
Prof. Kim Jin-woo (center) poses for a photo together with Dr. Lee Eun-jeong (right) from Celliaz and KAIST doctoral student Kim Moo-sung. (Photo courtesy of KAIST)
The research team explained, "The PROX1 protein secreted from damaged retinal nerve cells moves to Müller glia, inhibiting dedifferentiation into neural progenitor cells and neural regeneration. By capturing external PROX1 with a neutralizing antibody against PROX1, we can prevent its movement to Müller glia, restart the dedifferentiation and neural regeneration process of Müller glia cells, and restore retinal function."
This method utilizes antibodies that bind to Prox1, discovered by Celliaz Inc., a startup founded by Prof. Kim as a lab venture (a KAIST faculty startup).
In particular, it was proven that when the Prox1 neutralizing antibody was administered to disease-modeling mouse retinas, active neural regeneration occurred, and when delivered in the form of a gene therapy to congenital retinal degenerative disease mouse retinas, continuous generation of nerve cells and vision recovery were maintained for over six months.
Celliaz is currently developing a retinal regeneration-inducing treatment based on these research results to apply to various degenerative retinal diseases, with the goal of entering clinical trials by 2028.
This research, with Dr. Lee Eun-jeong from Celliaz and KAIST doctoral student Kim Moo-sung as co-first authors, was published online in the international journal "Nature Communications" on March 26 (Paper title: Restoration of retinal regenerative potential of Müller glia by disrupting intercellular Prox1 transfer).
Dr. Lee stated, "The work to improve the efficacy of the Prox1 neutralizing antibody is complete, and after evaluating its vision restoration efficacy and safety using various animals, we will proceed with administration to retinal disease patients," adding, "We will strive to make a practical contribution to patients at risk of blindness without appropriate treatment."

data.title: Ask HN: Are Squarespace and Wix sites worth it?
data.author: LouisLazaris
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：网页构建工具及其相关域名管理、SEO影响和开发者体验

不同观点：
• 观点一：网页构建工具是面向普通消费者的商品化产品。jayturley指出，这些工具主要是为了让用户自行构建网站，属于"获取网站"的初步商品化阶段。它们对于开发者而言，比开源工具（如WordPress、Laravel、Hugo等）更难扩展，且由于是封闭生态，迁移成本较高。
   
• 观点二：域名管理和所有权清晰。jayturley解释，这些工具提供商作为注册商，与其它注册商无异。用户可以在不同注册商之间自由转移域名，且在注册期内，用户拥有域名的实际控制权，工具提供商并不拥有用户的域名。

• 观点三：SEO优化依赖于用户自身的努力。jayturley提到，这些网页构建工具不会带来显著的SEO惩罚，但与所有网站一样，用户需要自行进行SEO优化工作，才能达到理想效果。

补充讨论：
• 关于开发者工具的选择，jayturley明确表示更偏好于开源工具，因为这些工具允许开发者自由改进、扩展，甚至可以通过实验性的编码进行探索，而网页构建工具则限制较多。

• 争议焦点：网页构建工具的封闭性和难以迁移的问题是讨论中的一个争议点。一方面，这些工具为没有技术背景的用户提供了便捷的建站途径，但另一方面，对于有技术需求的开发者而言，它们的扩展性和灵活性不足，且一旦使用，用户会面临较高的迁移成本。

data.title: Why I run FreeBSD for my home servers (2024)
data.author: psxuaw
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了2024年Linux作为桌面操作系统的优异表现，尤其是在EndeavourOS发行版上的体验，指出其在日常使用中的良好表现，包括游戏、程序安装和设备连接等方面。然而，作为服务器操作系统，Linux特别是基于RedHat的系统，因SystemD的复杂性和过多的抽象层（如Docker和Kubernetes）而显得混乱，增加了故障排查的难度。文章批评了SystemD导致的系统复杂性和可靠性问题，并对比了不同Linux发行版在包管理和网络配置上的差异。作者还称赞了FreeBSD在生产环境中的简单性和稳定性，认为其无重大变更的升级体验更适合专业使用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：FreeBSD与Linux（尤其是systemd相关）的比较，以及在不同应用场景下的优缺点讨论。

不同观点：
• nine_k认为，systemd、Kubernetes等并不是必须的，用户有其他选择（如Void Linux），且容器技术并不复杂，类似于BSD的jails。FreeBSD的优势在于ZFS、内核和网络栈等，而非因为一些人提到的Linux常见问题。
• solid_fuel强调FreeBSD的管理工具稳定，不常变化，如`ifconfig`长期保持一致，减少了管理员的困扰。相比之下，Linux的管理工具变化较频繁，更新时可能导致习惯的工具被移除或改变。
• asveikau选择FreeBSD的主要原因是ZFS，并从哲学上更倾向于*BSD系统，同时也在使用OpenBSD和Linux。
• aeblyve引用了Schneier的博客，讨论了“廉价复杂性”问题，认为systemd虽然增加了复杂性，但也解决了许多问题，是技术进步的一部分。
• carlhjerpe对systemd持积极态度，认为它适合大多数人，不认同对systemd的抱怨。
• rollcat对FreeBSD有复杂的感受，认为其在某些方面优于Linux（如ZFS体验、man页面等），但在某些方面又显得混乱（如多个防火墙、配置文件分散等）。相比OpenBSD，FreeBSD在桌面和使用便捷性上较为落后。
• lunarlull认为，BSD的优势不再明显，许多核心性能改进首先出现在Linux上，最终选择多取决于用户偏好，并推荐了Alpine、Void等无systemd的Linux发行版。
• tracker1从个人经验出发，强调在家庭服务器和小型项目中，使用Linux和Docker能快速搭建和迁移，减少了管理复杂性。
• steeleduncan反驳了“复杂技术易失败”的观点，认为设计良好的复杂技术是可靠的，并指出许多对systemd的抱怨源于不愿学习新工具。
• csdvrx支持systemd，认为其提供了更好的功能，尤其是在需要复杂逻辑时。同时指出，许多人因为不愿学习新工具而拒绝使用systemd，导致问题。
• mycall对系统可靠性提出了技术性问题，质疑个体组件可靠性对整体系统可靠性的影响。
• npodbielski认为，尽管作者提出的某些观点有道理，但普通用户并不想花时间管理服务器，需要更简单的自托管解决方案，如一键部署和自动更新。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点主要集中在systemd的优缺点、FreeBSD与Linux的管理便捷性和工具稳定性上。
• 一些评论者强调了个人偏好和技术需求对操作系统选择的影响，而另一些则讨论了技术进步带来的复杂性及其合理性。
• 自托管和简化服务器管理的呼声较高，特别是针对普通用户的需求。

• aeblyve引用了Schneier的博客，讨论了“廉价复杂性”问题，认为systemd虽然增加了复杂性，但也解决了许多问题，是技术进步的一部分。
• carlhjerpe对systemd持积极态度，认为它适合大多数人，不认同对systemd的抱怨。
• rollcat对FreeBSD有复杂的感受，认为其在某些方面优于Linux（如ZFS体验、man页面等），但在某些方面又显得混乱（如多个防火墙、配置文件分散等）。相比OpenBSD，FreeBSD在桌面和使用便捷性上较为落后。
• lunarlull认为，BSD的优势不再明显，许多核心性能改进首先出现在Linux上，最终选择多取决于用户偏好，并推荐了Alpine、Void等无systemd的Linux发行版。
• tracker1从个人经验出发，强调在家庭服务器和小型项目中，使用Linux和Docker能快速搭建和迁移，减少了管理复杂性。
• steeleduncan反驳了“复杂技术易失败”的观点，认为设计良好的复杂技术是可靠的，并指出许多对systemd的抱怨源于不愿学习新工具。
• csdvrx支持systemd，认为其提供了更好的功能，尤其是在需要复杂逻辑时。同时指出，许多人因为不愿学习新工具而拒绝使用systemd，导致问题。
• mycall对系统可靠性提出了技术性问题，质疑个体组件可靠性对整体系统可靠性的影响。
• npodbielski认为，尽管作者提出的某些观点有道理，但普通用户并不想花时间管理服务器，需要更简单的自托管解决方案，如一键部署和自动更新。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点主要集中在systemd的优缺点、FreeBSD与Linux的管理便捷性和工具稳定性上。
• 一些评论者强调了个人偏好和技术需求对操作系统选择的影响，而另一些则讨论了技术进步带来的复杂性及其合理性。
• 自托管和简化服务器管理的呼声较高，特别是针对普通用户的需求。

data.title: Oracle attempt to hide cybersecurity incident from customers?
data.author: 2bluesc
data.article_summary: Oracle被指试图隐瞒其SaaS服务中的严重网络安全事件。3月21日，Bleeping Computer报道了黑客rose87168声称入侵了Oracle的*.oraclecloud.com服务。Oracle否认了这一 breach，称“没有客户数据泄露”。然而，黑客提供了访问Oracle系统的证据，包括登录其管理服务的权限，并发布了一个内部会议录音，显示Oracle员工讨论了密码库和客户系统被入侵的情况。多位Oracle客户确认数据被泄露。尽管Oracle试图删除证据并避免书面确认，但多个消息来源证实了这起安全事件。Oracle被批评未公开透明地处理此事，建议其应明确告知客户事件详情及应对措施。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Oracle安全事件及公司应对方式引发的争议

不同观点：
• [legitster] 认为Oracle的客户选择该公司通常是因为企业高层的幕后交易，而不是因为其产品质量。用户对Oracle的此类事件并不感到意外或愤怒，因为客户没有其他选择。
• [nerdjon] 强调安全事件在近年已变得普遍，如果Oracle坦诚面对，事件可能很快被遗忘，但其强烈否认和不透明的态度使问题变得更严重，质疑其动机和诚信。
• [autoexec] 指出当前州法律对数据泄露通知的要求缺乏执行力，呼吁需要更具威慑力的联邦法律来规范公司行为。
• [prdonahue] 分享了其与Oracle销售代表的沟通，Oracle方面否认了任何云客户数据泄露，但未提供详细说明。
• [mentalgear] 将此事件与Oracle创始人Larry Ellison的其他丑闻联系起来，认为这是其一贯作风。
• [islanderfun] 认为Oracle的当前行为符合“后真相时代”的特点，并指出这是Oracle长期以来的标准操作。
• [homiedk] 关注的是Oracle在安全事件中的技术控制缺失，如缺乏网络监控和安全响应机制，导致无法及时发现和阻止攻击。
• [tmpz22] 认为Oracle应依靠其良好声誉，向长期忠诚客户请求原谅。
• [layman51] 提到Oracle有能力删除Archive.org上的内容，暗示其影响力令人担忧。
• [richwater] 认为Oracle的行为符合其一贯预期，但对尚未涉及企业合同感到惊讶。
• [NickC25] 质疑Oracle是否构成证券欺诈，认为公司有法律义务告知投资者此类事件。
• [xyst] 认为Oracle故意掩盖其无能，主张这种欺骗公众和付费客户的行为应受到刑事处罚，并呼吁高管承担法律责任。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于Oracle对安全事件的否认态度和信息不透明，以及公司是否应对客户和公众承担更多责任。
• 讨论中多次提到Oracle的声誉和过往行为，表明该公司在处理安全事件上的历史可能影响了公众的看法。
• 法律和监管问题也被提及，特别是关于公司是否应因不披露安全事件而受到更严厉的惩罚。

43535953.article_content:
Oracle attempt to hide serious cybersecurity incident from customers in Oracle SaaS service
Kevin Beaumont
·
Follow
Published in
DoublePulsar
·
4 min read
·
1 day ago
--
6
Listen
Share
Being a provider of cloud SaaS (Software-as-a-service) solutions requires certain cybersecurity responsibilities — including being transparent and open. The moment where this is tested at Oracle has arrived, as they have a serious cybersecurity incident playing out in a service they manage for customers.
Back on March 21st, Bleeping Computer ran a story around a threat actor named rose87168 claiming to have breached some Oracle services inside *.oraclecloud.com
Oracle
told
Bleeping Computer, and customers, “There has been no breach of Oracle Cloud. The published credentials are not for the Oracle Cloud. No Oracle Cloud customers experienced a breach or lost any data”
The threat actor then posted an archive.org URL and provided it to Bleeping Computer, strongly suggesting they had write access to login.us2.oraclecloud.com, a service using Oracle Access Manager. This server is entirely managed by Oracle:
https://cyberplace.social/@GossiTheDog/114202395143978043
Oracle have since requested Archive.org take down the proof:
The threat actor then provided a several hour long recording of an internal Oracle meeting, complete with Oracle employees talking for two hours:
The meeting is viewable
here
and the transcript is here:
https://github.com/j-klawson/oracle_breach_2025/blob/main/youtube_video_transcript.txt
The two hour video includes things like accessing internal Oracle password vaults, and customer facing systems:
I’ve masked the root passwords of Oracle’s systems
Both Hudson Rock and Bleeping Computer were then able to confirm with Oracle customers that their data — including staff email addresses — was in data released by the threat actor:
Oracle customers confirm data stolen in alleged cloud breach is valid
Despite Oracle denying a breach of its Oracle Cloud federated SSO login servers and the theft of account data for 6…
www.bleepingcomputer.com
The threat actor, rose87168, is still active online and releasing data — and threatening to release more:
They have also released data to cybersecurity threat intelligence providers.
In data released to a journalist for validation, it has now become 100% clear to me that there has been cybersecurity incident at Oracle, involving systems which processed customer data.
For example, the threat actor has publicly provided complete Oracle configuration files — current, too. As one example, they have provided Oracle webserver configuration files:
All the systems impacted are directly managed by Oracle. Some of the data provided to journalists is current, too. This is a serious cybersecurity incident which impacts customers, in a platform managed by Oracle.
Oracle are attempting to wordsmith statements around Oracle Cloud and use very specific words to avoid responsibility.
This is not okay.
Oracle need to clearly, openly and publicly communicate what happened, how it impacts customers, and what they’re doing about it. This is a matter of trust and responsibility. Step up, Oracle — or customers should start stepping off.
Update 1
— Oracle rebadged old Oracle Cloud services to be Oracle Classic. Oracle Classic has the security incident.
Oracle are denying it on “Oracle Cloud” by using this scope — but it’s still Oracle cloud services that Oracle manage. That’s part of the wordplay.
Update 2
— although Oracle
used the archive.org exclusion process
to remove evidence of writing to one of the Oraclecloud.com webservers, they forgot to remove the 2nd URL (click picture for hyperlink).
The threat actor’s email address
Update 3
— Multiple Oracle cloud customers have reached out to me to say Oracle have now confirmed a breach of their services.
They are only doing so verbally, they will not write anything down, so they’re setting up meetings with large customers who query.
This is similar behaviour to the breach of medical PII in the ongoing breach at Oracle Health, where they will only provide details verbally and not in writing:
Oracle Health breach compromises patient data at US hospitals
A breach at Oracle Health impacts multiple US healthcare organizations and hospitals after a threat actor stole patient…
www.bleepingcomputer.com
https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-03-28/oracle-warns-health-customers-of-patient-data-breach
Additional information has come to light on the security issues with Oracle Classic aka OCI Gen1 - I am investigating.
You can follow me on Mastodon for the latest updates, if you want:
https://cyberplace.social/invite/hHiX8ntL
or @gossithedog@cyberplace.social

data.title: A 6-Hour Time-Stretched Version of Brian Eno's Music for Airports
data.author: vinhnx
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了布莱恩·伊诺（Brian Eno）的经典环境音乐专辑《机场音乐》（Music for Airports）。该专辑于1978年创作，旨在通过缓慢、冥想的音乐让听众接受死亡的自然性。专辑使用了数秒长的磁带循环，打破了传统的大小调音阶，探索了背景音的运用。虽然最初为私人使用而作，但后来在多个机场和音乐会上演出。2025年，一位YouTube用户创建了6小时的延展版，让音乐更加无缝和冥想。文章还提到环境音乐在公共空间的潜在应用，并呼吁支持开放文化的教育使命。读者评论则讨论了在不同场景中使用舒缓音乐的必要性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕Brian Eno的 ambient 音乐及其影响和相关作品的讨论

不同观点：
• [okeuro49] 引用了Brian Eno对机场背景音乐的思考，认为机场等场所的音乐不应只是无意义的背景音，而应与空间氛围契合，甚至反映出乘客面对飞行风险时的心理状态。
• [jquaint] 推荐了一个名为paulstretch的音频处理工具，可以用于制作类似Enos的 ambient 音乐，并分享了一个应用实例。
• [tquinn] 提到了电影《Heat》的背景音乐，认为它也是适合工作时听的 ambient 音乐，展示了对类似类型音乐的个人偏好。
• [matteason] 分享了一个互动式的 ambient 音景网页应用Ambiphone，并提供了应用示例和当前的开发状态。
• [morsch] 提出了自己更喜欢The Black Dog的Music for Real Airports，认为其与Eno的风格类似但更符合个人口味。

补充讨论：
• [ocal5] 和 [Lutzb] 提到了Brian Eno创作的Windows 95启动音乐，并分享了其慢速版本链接，扩展了Eno作品的范围。
• [curiousigor] 指出了访问某些网站时可能遇到的地区锁定问题，虽然没有具体结论，但提出了技术上的挑战。
• [bevan] 分享了一部关于Eno的纪录片，强调其与Eno的生成式音乐理念的关联。
• [ddxv] 推荐了Stars of the Lkd的音乐，为寻找类似氛围音乐的人提供了更多选择。
• [andyjohnson0] 表达了对Bang On A Can版本的偏爱，尽管其并非Eno的原作，展示了不同版本作品之间的比较。
• [CompoundEyes] 提到Steve Roach的“Structures from Silence”，通过音乐背后的故事（濒死体验）进一步探讨了音乐与生命脆弱性的关联。
• [chaosprint] 认为paulstretch工具可以广泛应用于各种音乐，以创造类似的ambient效果，扩展了工具的适用范围。
• [cage433] 推荐了Igor Levit演奏的Satie's Vexations，为那些觉得Eno音乐过短的人提供了更长的选择。
• [kryptonomist] 简单提及了某位适合深夜编码时听的音乐家，但没有具体展开。

争议焦点：
- 不同用户对ambient音乐的偏好和推荐不同作品，体现了主观审美差异。
- 对特定工具（如paulstretch）和音乐版本（如Bang On A Can vs. 原版）的偏好也展示了个人选择的多样性。

A 6‑Hour Time-Stretched Version of Brian Eno’s
Music For Airports
: Meditate, Relax, Study
in
Music
|   	March 17th, 2025
3 Comments
Writ­ing in his 1995 diary about his sem­i­nal ambi­ent album
Music for Air­ports
, Eno remem­bered his ini­tial thoughts going into it: “I want to make a kind of music that pre­pares you for dying–that doesn’t get all bright and cheer­ful and pre­tend you’re not a lit­tle appre­hen­sive, but which makes you say to your­self, ‘Actu­al­ly, it’s not that big a deal if I die.’”
Cre­at­ed in 1978 from sec­onds-long tape loops from a much longer improv ses­sion with musi­cians includ­ing Robert Wyatt,
Music for Air­ports
start­ed the idea of slow, med­i­ta­tive music that aban­doned typ­i­cal major and minor scales, brought in melod­ic ambi­gu­i­ty, and began the explo­ration of sounds that were designed to exist some­where in the back­ground, beyond the scope of full atten­tion.
For those who think 50 min­utes is too short and those piano notes too rec­og­niz­able, may we sug­gest this 6‑hour, time-stretched ver­sion of the album, cre­at­ed by YouTube user “Slow Motion TV.” The tonal field is the same, but now the notes are no attack, all decay. It’s gran­u­lar as hell, but you could imag­ine the whole piece unspool­ing unno­ticed in a ter­mi­nal while a flight is delayed for the third time. (Maybe that’s when the accep­tance of death hap­pens, when you’ve giv­en up on ever get­ting home?)
Unlike
Music for Films
, which fea­tured sev­er­al tracks Eno had giv­en to film­mak­ers like Derek Jar­man, it took some time for
Music for Air­ports
to be real­ized in its intend­ed loca­tion: being piped in at a ter­mi­nal at La Guardia, New York, some­time in the 1980s. And that was just a one-time thing.
?si=6VMY_yEfZdFDZbp6
The album seemed des­tined for per­son­al use only, but then in 1997 the mod­ern ensem­ble Bang on a Can played it live, trans­lat­ing the ran­dom­ness of out-of-sync tape loops into music nota­tion. Over the years they’ve per­formed it at air­ports in Brus­sels, the Nether­lands and Liv­er­pool, and in 2015 the group brought it to Ter­mi­nal 2 of San Diego Inter­na­tion­al.
Writ­ing for KCET, Alex Zaragoza report­ed
that “cry­ing babies, echoes of rolling suit­cas­es and board­ing pass­es serv­ing as tick­ets to the con­cert failed to remind any­one that they were, indeed, at one of the busiest air­ports in the coun­try. Even the tell­tale announce­ments were there:
Air­port secu­ri­ty is every­one’s respon­si­bil­i­ty. Do not leave bags unat­tend­ed
.”
And then in 2018,
Lon­don City Air­port played the orig­i­nal album
in a day-long loop for the album’s 40th anniver­sary.
As site-spe­cif­ic mul­ti-media art builds pop­u­lar­i­ty in the 21st cen­tu­ry with increas­ing­ly cheap­er and small­er tech­nol­o­gy, we might hope to hear ambi­ent drones, and not clas­sic rock or pop, in more and more land­scapes.
Note: An ear­li­er ver­sion of this post appeared on our site in 2019.

data.title: Where does air pollution come from?
data.author: kamaraju
data.article_summary: 每年数百万人因空气污染过早死亡。自人类开始燃烧材料作为燃料起，这一问题就已存在，从最初的木材和生物质到后来的化石燃料。然而，这是一个我们可以取得进展的环境和公共健康问题，因为全球已在减少空气污染物方面取得成功，许多曾经高度污染的国家如今空气已变得更清洁。为了有效应对空气污染，我们需要了解其来源。本文使用社区排放数据系统（CEDS）提供的长期全球和国家数据，该数据可追溯至18世纪，并定期更新至2022年。CEDS数据通过模型计算得出，具有一定不确定性，但为我们提供了全球排放趋势的合理一致的数据集。本文重点分析污染物来源，并按CEDS的分类进行细分，包括农业、建筑、能源、工业、交通和废物等类别。空气污染通过直接暴露和颗粒物形成等方式损害健康，导致大量过早死亡。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：空气污染的成因、影响、监管及测量问题

不同观点：
• alexmccain6：认为空气污染的影响是隐性但广泛的，特别是对公共健康的长远影响。同时，对国际监管压力（如IMO 2020）如何促使航运业减少SO₂排放表示关注，并质疑是全球协调和监控的作用更大，还是因为替代方案的经济可行性更高。
• dynm：提出一个令人意外的污染源，即海浪飞沫（sea spray），认为其对沿海地区的PM2.5有显著贡献，但具体数据难以获取。
• xlii：对污染监测的实际执行表示怀疑，提到一些小镇存在污染但未被监测到，且地方当局反对安装传感器。质疑全球的环保努力是否对小规模污染者有效，尤其是与大型污染者对比时。
• sebastiennight：认为城市中的“煤烟”污染部分来源于汽车轮胎的磨损，而不仅仅是燃烧排放。
• TimByte：指出许多污染物都源自燃烧过程，无论是化石燃料还是农业副产品，本质上都是不同形式的燃烧和分解。
• pjsousa79：通过数据指出空气污染对低收入国家儿童健康的影响尤为严重，列举了多个国家因空气污染导致五岁以下儿童死亡的数据。
• johnthesecure：对空气污染导致的死亡数据持怀疑态度，认为许多死者即使没有污染也可能因其他原因死亡，建议讨论生活质量年（QUALYs）的损失可能更有意义。
• OsrsNeedsf2P：建议使用人均死亡率而不是绝对死亡数进行国家间比较，以便更准确地反映各国污染影响。
• nomilk：质疑城市空气质量监测数据的准确性，认为监测点的位置可能导致数据偏差，提出微环境对个人实际空气质量体验的影响更大。
• phtrivier：对航运业如何接受并遵守燃料更换规定表示好奇，质疑是替代燃料的经济性，还是行业受到某种强制或标准变更的影响。
• PeterStuer：批评一些国家通过将污染产业转移到其他国家来实现“绿色”和“净零排放”，实际上并未真正减少全球污染。
• kpmcc：对文章中使用的交互图表表示兴趣，询问所用的绘图库。
• h1fra：担心农业相关的污染（如氨和甲烷）没有减少的迹象，认为改变全球70亿人的饮食习惯几乎不可能。
• spwa4：希望文章能更多关注已取得的环保进展，例如过去使用含铅汽油造成的损害比现在的NOx问题严重得多。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是空气污染监测和执行的有效性，尤其是地方当局的抵制和小镇未被监测到的问题。
• 另一个争议点是对污染导致的死亡数据的解读，johnthesecure质疑这些死亡是否由于其他健康问题而被误认为是污染导致的。
• 国际监管和行业合规的背后动机也是讨论的一个重点，phtrivier质疑航运业是如何被说服接受更昂贵的替代燃料的。
• 农业污染（如氨和甲烷）的持续增加被认为是未来治理的难点，尤其是改变全球饮食习惯的难度。

Home
Air Pollution
Millions of people
die prematurely
from air pollution every year.
This problem has existed
since humans started burning materials for fuel — first wood and biomass, then fossil fuels.
But it’s an environmental and public health problem that we can make progress on. We know this because the world
has already
been successful
in reducing air pollutants, and many countries that used to be highly polluted now have much cleaner air than they used to.
To tackle air pollution effectively — to focus our efforts on the interventions that will have the biggest impact — we need to understand where it’s coming from.
That’s why we wrote this article.
1
A note on data and definitions
The main data source we rely on is the Community Emissions Data System (CEDS). There are a couple of reasons why we think it’s an incredibly valuable resource:
It has long-term global and national data extending back to the 18th century and is frequently updated with the latest estimates for 2022.
It’s published with an open-access license and transparent methodology and inputs, which you can find
on GitHub
. The peer-reviewed paper describing the methodology is
here
.
2
This online data resource is open to user comments and feedback, so errors or issues can be easily reported.
CEDS provides clear documentation of data improvements and detailed comparisons of recent updates against previous versions.
To be clear, CEDS does not have high-quality
measurements
of emissions of air pollutants — certainly not dating back to the 18th century. These figures are calculated and modeled based on inputs, such as the quantity of different fuels that were burned, technological advancements and pollution controls, fertilizer use, and agricultural production. You can, for example, estimate the amount of sulfur dioxide produced from burning one tonne of coal in a power plant (with or without pollution filters).
Of course, this means the data comes with some uncertainty, especially in earlier periods. However, it gives us a reasonable and consistent global dataset to understand how trends in emissions of air pollutants have changed over time.
This article will focus on the breakdown of pollutants by their source. For this, we’ll use a categorization based on CEDS’s classification. In the table below, we summarize what is included in each category.

How air pollution damages our health
Before we discuss the sources of some of the key air pollutants, we should briefly explain how air pollution affects human health and how each of these pollutants contributes to this.
There are three key pathways by which a pollutant can cause harm
3

Direct exposure:
Some gases are toxic and can have an acute effect on health. These acute impacts are more common for people with existing respiratory conditions such as asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). This direct exposure does cost lives, but the total number is relatively small compared to the millions that die from chronic exposure to air pollution.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI工具在代码调试、软件开发以及其他领域（如食谱生成、语音控制）中的应用和潜力

不同观点：
• **jumploops** 认为，虽然Claude Code在处理独立软件问题时最终能解决问题，但在调试困难问题时，o1 Pro表现更为出色。他提到在与同事对比测试中，o1 Pro能一次性解决问题，而Claude Code需要多次迭代。尽管最终完成时间相近，但o1 Pro帮助解决了Claude未发现的问题。
  
• **nine_k** 对自动化工具在非技术人员中的应用持怀疑态度，认为不仅需要AI具备编码能力，还需要其具备架构和高级软件工程师的能力，才能让非技术人员有效使用。特别指出，要让非技术人员理解如日志跟踪和版本控制等概念是一个重大挑战。
  
• **osigurdson** 表示，目前Windsurf与Claude的实用性有限，虽然未来可能会有突破，但目前主要用途在于教学而非实际编码。他认为ChatGPT在当前阶段作为AI编辑器已经足够。

• **iambateman** 关注自动化系统在维护项目中的上下文理解能力，提出如果大量代码被误操作（如3k LOC被重复），AI系统能否理解并修复。他预测未来可能会出现LLM意外重新实现整个功能的新型错误。

补充讨论：
• **apgwoz** 和 **ttd** 对食谱网站的生成内容提出质疑和批评，前者因过敏反应而愤怒，后者对食谱中的奇怪食材表示嘲讽。
  
• **Yiling-J** 推荐了自己的工具tablepilot，用于生成大量食谱，表明AI在特定任务中已有实际应用。
  
• **peterldowns** 和 **low_tech_love** 对项目的语音控制和区块链结合等创新点表示赞赏，认为这是技术的前沿应用。

• **Retr0id** 和 **DidYaWipe** 则关注用户体验问题，如界面错误和术语不清晰，表明项目在实际应用中仍有改进空间。

• **tombert** 分享了使用Conjure插件在Clojure中的积极体验，认为这种即时执行和反馈的编码方式改变了编码习惯，并对Rust中缺乏类似功能表示遗憾。

争议焦点：
• AI工具在调试和代码生成中的实际效果和应用场景。
• 非技术人员能否通过AI工具有效参与软件开发。
• 自动化系统在处理复杂代码问题时的可靠性和潜在错误。

• **osigurdson** 表示，目前Windsurf与Claude的实用性有限，虽然未来可能会有突破，但目前主要用途在于教学而非实际编码。他认为ChatGPT在当前阶段作为AI编辑器已经足够。

• **iambateman** 关注自动化系统在维护项目中的上下文理解能力，提出如果大量代码被误操作（如3k LOC被重复），AI系统能否理解并修复。他预测未来可能会出现LLM意外重新实现整个功能的新型错误。

补充讨论：
• **apgwoz** 和 **ttd** 对食谱网站的生成内容提出质疑和批评，前者因过敏反应而愤怒，后者对食谱中的奇怪食材表示嘲讽。
  
• **Yiling-J** 推荐了自己的工具tablepilot，用于生成大量食谱，表明AI在特定任务中已有实际应用。
  
• **peterldowns** 和 **low_tech_love** 对项目的语音控制和区块链结合等创新点表示赞赏，认为这是技术的前沿应用。

• **Retr0id** 和 **DidYaWipe** 则关注用户体验问题，如界面错误和术语不清晰，表明项目在实际应用中仍有改进空间。

• **tombert** 分享了使用Conjure插件在Clojure中的积极体验，认为这种即时执行和反馈的编码方式改变了编码习惯，并对Rust中缺乏类似功能表示遗憾。

争议焦点：
• AI工具在调试和代码生成中的实际效果和应用场景。
• 非技术人员能否通过AI工具有效参与软件开发。
• 自动化系统在处理复杂代码问题时的可靠性和潜在错误。

data.title: Converting a Go-Kart into a Deathtrap
data.author: mattogodoy
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了作者计划将一个简单的脚踏卡丁车改造成一辆电动汽车的过程。改造目标包括使用电动马达、保持小尺寸以便运输、具备足够的动力和安全性，并能应对各种地形。作者设定了两个驾驶模式：手动模式和遥控模式，以确保安全。卡丁车的底盘选用了一辆二手脚踏卡丁车，并加装了MDF木板以增强结构。马达来自废弃的平衡车，具备强劲的动力和紧凑的设计。电池选用36V、10Ah的型号，并安装了放电保护系统和电量显示屏。此外，还使用电压转换器为电子设备和灯光提供不同电压。整个项目旨在为作者的孩子打造一辆既安全又有趣的电动卡丁车。

43525129.article_content:
Este artículo también está
disponible en Español
🇪🇸
As a child, I always dreamed of having vehicles that I could drive myself. I remember putting a chair with a fan in front of it and pretending to fly an airplane.
The Plan
Now that my son is about to turn 3, I thought I could do something similar for him. I came up with the idea of transforming a boring pedal go-kart into an incredibly powerful and dangerous, and therefore, super fun electric car.
Requirements
Before starting the project, I defined a series of basic requirements:
Motor:
It has to be powered by an electric motor, because we no longer live in 1940.
Size:
It has to be small, so it’s easy to drive and fits in the trunk for transportation.
Power:
There are many models of electric go-karts for children. A good example is those that can be rented at shopping centers. These, in addition to being of very poor quality, have very little power, very little final speed, and their controls are usually all-or-nothing, meaning you can’t control speed or direction proportionally. They either accelerate or not.
Speed Limiter:
As it’s a car for children, it has to be safe (within reason). For this, the car must have some means to limit the maximum speed it can reach. This speed can be set very low at first and increased as the child gains experience.
Driving Modes:
Continuing with safety measures, my idea is that the car should have 2 driving modes:
Manual:
Speed, brakes, direction (forward or reverse), steering, and speed limiter are controlled by the driver themselves. This will be ideal when the child is a bit older and has some driving experience.
Radio-controlled:
Speed, brakes, direction, and speed limiter are controlled with a radio like those used for radio-controlled cars. The steering control will remain manual (at least for now).
All-terrain:
Cars that can only go on asphalt are boring. Nothing better than going through dirt, stones, and mud on a difficult terrain. This kart has to have good ground clearance and be able to handle any obstacle.
Tires:
They have to be of the inflatable kind to counteract the lack of suspension. They are also necessary for the car to be all-terrain.
Components
The go-kart
The kart had to be the right size for children between 3 and 6 years old. After looking around, I found a used pedal go-kart in very good condition that would serve as the base structure for the project:
With this, I solved important things like the steering mechanism and the seat, in addition to the overall structure.
The floor
The original pedal kart structure is quite flimsy and didn’t have anywhere to attach the motors or support the pedals and feet. I decided to use a 16mm thick MDF wood base cut to a specific size and shape to fit the kart. On this base, the motors, pedals, battery, and electronics box will be mounted. It will also give the car good rigidity.
The motors
In the past, Hoverboards (another deadly trap for kids) became very popular. Today, the Hoverboard craze has passed, and most are abandoned, gathering dust. This means we can get them almost for free by buying them second-hand from some parent who’s tired of tripping over them in their kids’ bedroom.
A great advantage of these motors is that they fit inside the wheel, so they don’t take up any space. The motor IS the wheel. You just add a tire and go. Additionally, they are extremely powerful for their size. A Hoverboard can carry up to a 100 kg person uphill without issues.
Motor controllers
The Hoverboard motors are brushless, and they have magnetic sensors to know the motor’s position at all times. This allows for very good speed regulation. There are variants of these motors without sensors, but they don’t work well at low speeds.
After searching a bit, I found a controller called
ZS-X11H
that is incredibly cheap (costs about €12), especially compared to more decent controllers.
In addition to its price, it has the advantage of allowing you to change the direction of rotation, adjust the speed, and even has a braking function (more on this later). Additionally, their control inputs are analog by default, but by soldering a jumper, you can use PWM inputs. This will allow us to control them using an
Arduino Nano
.
The battery
The Hoverboard I took the motors from had a 36v battery, but it was very small and very dead. I wanted it to have plenty of autonomy, so I bought a 36v, 10Ah battery. With this, it should have enough autonomy for a while (I haven’t checked how long yet, but in my short experience, it lasts a lot).
A problem with most batteries is that they get ruined if they are over-discharged. That’s why I installed a discharge protection system that simply shuts off the kart when the battery voltage is too low:
And I also installed a small screen that shows the remaining charge and current voltage:
Voltage converters
I said that the battery is 36 volts, but we also need 5v to power the Arduino and the RC receiver, and 12v for the lights. For this, we use two voltage c

主要讨论点：对Val Kilmer去世的新闻及其演艺生涯的回顾与评价

不同观点：
• WalterBright认为Kilmer在《Real Genius》中的表现非常出色，并提到他在《Top Gun》中超越了Tom Cruise。他对Kilmer的电影表示赞赏。
• delichon认为Kilmer在《Maverick》中的出现是一种明显的粉丝服务，情感操控强烈，但也成功引起了观众的共鸣，并将这则新闻视作Kilmer职业生涯的终结。
• xnx高度评价《Real Genius》，认为其在编剧、表演、制作和科学可信度方面均属一流，不应仅仅被视为80年代的普通喜剧。
• toomuchtodo和js2仅提供了相关链接，未提供具体观点。
• wallabie提到Kilmer在《Heat》、《Ronin》和《Ocean's》系列中的表现，认为这些是抢劫类型电影的经典，并推荐了《Heat 2》小说。
• jaredklewis对Kilmer在《Tombstone》中饰演的Doc Holliday表示赞赏，认为其表演非常细致。
• blindriver和glimshe简单表达了对Kilmer去世的惋惜，特别提到他在《The Doors》中的表现。
• fl4tul4和xeromal对Kilmer在《The Saint》和《Tombstone》中的表现表示怀念，认为他是一位伟大的演员。
• mberning提到Kilmer对粉丝友好且慷慨，并感慨65岁去世显得过于年轻。

补充讨论：
• nullc的评论较为模糊，似乎在暗示某种逃避责任的倾向，但未具体说明。
• 总体而言，评论大多对Kilmer的演艺生涯表示肯定和怀念，尤其是在他饰演的几个标志性角色上，观众情感深厚。

data.title: The Guardian flourishes without a paywall
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: 《卫报》美国分部通过读者捐款大幅增加收入，以支持其无付费墙的新闻模式。文章指出，在其他媒体如《华盛顿邮报》和《洛杉矶时报》因受富豪影响而妥协其新闻 integrity 时，《卫报》强调其无富豪业主或企业压力的优势，特别是在特朗普政府威胁惩罚记者的背景下，坚守公平准确的报道显得尤为重要。自2015年起，《卫报》开始呼吁读者捐款，近年来因特朗普相关报道增多，捐款显著增加，预计今年在美加地区捐款收入将达4400万美元，同比增长33%。文章还提到，《卫报》通过全球视角吸引了大量读者，目前其美国读者数量已超过《华尔街日报》。尽管行业内对无付费墙模式存在质疑，《卫报》通过创新继续探索这一模式的可行性。

There was a time in media when having a billionaire owner was an asset. For many outlets, this is still the case, particularly those publishing

, both of which have seen their benefactors bend a knee to Donald Trump and sacrifice the integrity of their newspapers in the process, ownership has become a problem. A problem that the
Guardian

“All around us, media organizations have begun to capitulate,” editor Betsy Reed writes in the current fundraising appeal at the bottom of each
Guardian

The Guardian
has neither a self-interested billionaire owner nor profit-seeking corporate henchmen pressuring us to appease the rich and powerful. Can you support
The Guardian
today?”

The Guardian
; the biggest was the week of the 2024 presidential election.
The
Guardian

first-person account
by a Canadian citizen detained by ICE, for example, netted $105,000 in pledged donations. These contributions account for more than 60 percent of the American operation’s total revenue, which last year exceeded costs by $16 million (the rest of its revenue comes from advertising and philanthropic support from foundations). The Guardian

Times
. That is a real problem that we have an answer to.”

The Guardian
’s global perspective — the internal catchphrase of the U.S. operation is that it covers America for the world and the world for America — is also a draw at such a volatile moment in geopolitics. “People are even more interested now than they were six months ago,” he said. The
Guardian
US’ audience is split 50-50 between American and global readers.

reporting
on widespread secret surveillance by the National Security Agency. But as the Obama era gave way to the Trump era, the close association of the
Guardian
US with surveillance-state reporting made it less relevant to American readers. Annual losses led to
restructuring
that

the U.S. operation, once
housed

Guardian

hiring Reed
, formerly of
The Nation
and the Intercept, and
Sachs

data.title: Proof or Bluff? Evaluating LLMs on 2025 USA Math Olympiad
data.author: mauriziocalo
data.article_summary: 这篇文章评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）在2025年美国数学奥林匹克（USAMO）中的表现，重点考察其在复杂数学问题上的完整解答和证明能力。虽然当前最先进的模型在数学竞赛如AIME中表现出色，但这些评估仅基于最终答案，忽略了严格的推理和证明过程。作者通过专家标注对多个模型进行了详细评估，结果显示所有模型在USAMO的六道题目上表现不佳，平均得分不到5%。分析表明，模型在推理过程中存在多种常见错误和训练优化策略带来的不良影响。研究揭示了当前LLMs在严格数学推理任务上的不足，强调了提升其推理和证明能力的必要性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同机器学习模型在某项任务中的表现

不同观点：
• galaxyLogic指出，所有被测试的模型表现都很差，平均准确率不到5%。这表明当前的模型可能不足以解决该特定任务，或者任务本身具有很高的难度。
• [潜在的对立观点或补充] 一些人可能认为，尽管模型表现不佳，但这可能与数据质量、任务定义或模型选择有关，不一定完全反映模型的局限性。例如，任务可能涉及到非常细微的特征识别，现有模型无法捕捉。

补充讨论：
• 有人可能会建议，改进数据预处理、特征工程或尝试更复杂的模型架构（如引入自监督学习或增强数据集）可能提升模型表现。
• 另一个讨论点是任务的具体性质，是否属于某个特定领域（如自然语言处理、图像识别等），这可能会影响模型的适用性和表现。
• 争议的焦点可能在于，是否应继续优化现有模型，还是应从根本上重新思考任务的定义和解决方法。

Title:
Proof or Bluff? Evaluating LLMs on 2025 USA Math Olympiad
Authors:
Ivo Petrov
,
Jasper Dekoninck
,
Lyuben Baltadzhiev
,
Maria Drencheva
,
Kristian Minchev
,

,
Nikola Jovanović
,
Martin Vechev
View a PDF of the paper titled Proof or Bluff? Evaluating LLMs on 2025 USA Math Olympiad, by Ivo Petrov and 7 other authors
View PDF
Abstract:
Recent math benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) such as MathArena indicate that state-of-the-art reasoning models achieve impressive performance on mathematical competitions like AIME, with the leading model, o3-mini, achieving scores comparable to top human competitors. However, these benchmarks evaluate models solely based on final numerical answers, neglecting rigorous reasoning and proof generation which are essential for real-world mathematical tasks. To address this, we introduce the first comprehensive evaluation of full-solution reasoning for challenging mathematical problems. Using expert human annotators, we evaluated several state-of-the-art reasoning models on the six problems from the 2025 USAMO within hours of their release. Our results reveal that all tested models struggled significantly, achieving less than 5% on average. Through detailed analysis of reasoning traces, we identify the most common failure modes and find several unwanted artifacts arising from the optimization strategies employed during model training. Overall, our results suggest that current LLMs are inadequate for rigorous mathematical reasoning tasks, highlighting the need for substantial improvements in reasoning and proof generation capabilities.

Average person will be 40% poorer if world warms by 4C, new research shows
Experts say previous economic models underestimated impact of global heating – as well as likely ‘cascading supply chain disruptions’
Graham Readfearn
Tue 1 Apr 2025 03.58 EDT
Last modified on Tue 1 Apr 2025 06.25 EDT
Share
Economic models have systematically underestimated how global heating will affect people’s wealth, according to a new study that finds 4C warming will make the average person 40% poorer – an almost four-fold increase on some estimates.
The study by Australian scientists suggests average per person GDP across the globe will be reduced by 16% even if warming is kept to 2C above pre-industrial levels. This is a much greater reduction than previous estimates, which found the reduction would be 1.4%.
Scientists now estimate global temperatures will rise by 2.1C
even if countries hit short-term and long-term climate targets.
Tackling climate crisis will increase economic growth, OECD research finds
Read more
Criticisms have mounted in recent years that a set of economic tools known as integrated assessment models (IAM) – used to guide how much governments should invest in cutting greenhouse gas emissions – have failed to capture major risks from climate change, particularly extreme weather events.
The new study, in the journal
Environmental Research Letters
, took one of the most popular economic models and enhanced it with climate change forecasts to capture the impacts of extreme weather events across global supply chains.
Dr Timothy Neal, of the University of New South Wales’s Institute for climate risk and response and the lead author of the study, said the new research had looked at the likely impact of global heating of 4C – seen by many climate experts as catastrophic for the planet – finding it would make the average person 40% poorer. This compared with about 11% poorer when using the models without enhancements.
Previous economic models that “inadvertently concluded” even high levels of global heating would have only modest impacts on the global economy had “profound implications for climate policy”, Neal said.
He said economic models had tended to only account for changing weather on a local level, rather than how weather extremes like droughts or floods could affect global supply chains.
“In a hotter future, we can expect cascading supply chain disruptions triggered by extreme weather events worldwide,” Neal said.
Prof Andy Pitman, a climate scientist at UNSW and co-author of the research, said: “It’s in the extremes when the rubber hits the road. It isn’t about average temperatures”
“Retooling economic models to account for extremes in your part of the world and its impact on supply chains feels like a very urgent thing to do so countries can fully cost their economic vulnerabilities to climate change and then do the obvious thing – cut emissions.”
Some economists have argued global losses from global heating might be partially balanced by warming that could benefit some cold regions, such as Canada, Russia and northern Europe. But Neal said global heating would hit countries everywhere, because global economies are linked by trade.
Prof Frank Jotzo, a climate policy expert at Australian National University who was not involved in the research, said economic climate modelling using IAMs assumed that if climate change made an activity such as agriculture unviable in one part of the world, increased output would simply come from somewhere else.
“The result is that the models say that climate change makes little difference to the future world economy, which is contrary to what physical impact science and a nuanced understanding of interdependencies in the economy would suggest.”
A
report in January
from the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, representing the profession that underpins the risk management decisions of the world’s insurers and pension funds, said previous economic risk assessments had failed to account for real-world climate impacts like “tipping points, extreme events, migration, sea level rise, human health impacts or geopolitical risk.”
“The benign but flawed results may reinforce the narrative that these are slow-moving risks with limited impacts, rather than severe risks requiring immediate action,” the report said.
Mark Lawrence researches climate risk as a professor of practice at the University of Adelaide and previouslyworked in financial risk management with senior roles at major financial institutions including Merrill Lynch and ANZ Banking Group. He said the results of the new research were credible.

data.author: zfg
data.article_summary: 石器时代工具的发现可能改变对人类起源的认识。在中国云南龙潭遗址出土的石器具有与尼安德特人相关的基纳风格，这在东亚尚属首次。这些工具可追溯至6万至5万年前，适应了当时寒冷气候。研究者提出两种可能：尼安德特人可能迁徙至中国，或当地古人类独立发展出相似工具。这一发现挑战了对人类进化和迁移的现有理解，但要确认尼安德特人在该地区的存在，仍需找到其化石证据。

43553142.article_content:
The discovery of stone tools at the Longtan site in China's Yunnan province suggests the region may once have been home to Neanderthals, according to a new study.
Qi-Jun Ruan/Hao Li
Sign up for CNN’s Wonder Theory science newsletter.
Explore the universe with news on fascinating discoveries, scientific advancements and more
.
Summary
Stone tools discovered in southwest China could challenge what's known about human origins during the Stone Age.
The tools, found at Longtan site, were crafted in Neanderthal-associated Quina style, unprecedented in East Asia.
Neanderthals might have migrated to China or other ancient humans developed similar tools, researchers suggest.
The stone tools were adapted for harsh climates similar to conditions in Europe 60,000 to 50,000 years ago.
Finding Neanderthal fossils in China would be necessary to definitively prove their presence in the region.
This summary was AI-generated and reviewed by CNN editors.
CNN
—
Stone tools unearthed in southwest China helped a mysterious group eke out a living in a cold and harsh environment 60,000 to 50,000 years ago.
But whose hands shaped them? The answer could shake up what’s known about human origins during this period of the Stone Age, according to new research.
Archaeologists excavating the Longtan site in Yunnan province, on the southwestern edge of the Tibetan Plateau, uncovered hundreds of stone artifacts from two trenches dug into the region’s reddish, silty clay.
The research team determined many of the tools were crafted in the style known as Quina, which is typically regarded as an archaeological signature of Neanderthals, a species of ancient human. The style, or complex, hasn’t been found in East Asia before, the study published Monday in the journal
Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
said.
The discovery marks the first time the style of stone tool associated with Neanderthals, called Quina, has been found in East Asia, the study team said.
Qi-Jun Ruan/Hao Li
“The discovery at the Longtan site is remarkable, as it documents this particular tradition far (at least 7,000 or 8,000 kilometers) from the region traditionally associated with this techno-cultural complex,” study coauthor Davide Delpiano, a postdoctoral fellow in Paleolithic archaeology at the University of Ferrara in Italy, said via email.
Neanderthals roamed Eurasia for some 400,000 years before disappearing 40,000 years ago, but there is no evidence of their remains east of the Altai Mountains in southern Siberia.
Neanderthal bones and skeletons have previously been found alongside Quina stone tools at several sites in Western Europe including at the namesake site of La Quina in southwest France. Quina is one of a number of stone tool styles associated with Neanderthals that archaeologists call
Mousterian culture
.
The unprecedented discovery at Longtan had “significant implications,” Delpiano said, raising two competing possibilities. Neanderthals could have migrated east and reached what’s now China, or a different species of ancient human possibly made stone tools uncannily similar to those being made in Europe during this period known as the Middle Paleolithic.
Stone tools with far-reaching implications
The tool set unearthed at Longtan in 2019 and 2020 include scrapers, used to work hides or wood with one sharp side, stone points that might have been attached to wooden spears, and tools that had notches a bit like a saw.
In Europe, Neanderthals used Quina stone tools during a dry and cold period 60,000 to 50,000 years ago in a landscape of open woodland. The tools would have helped Neanderthals hunt migrating herds of reindeer, giant deer, horses and bison, according to the study.
Quina tools typically had a long period of use and were often retouched and recycled — suggesting they were a response to patchy resources and a highly mobile lifestyle, the researchers wrote.
Analysis of ancient pollen grains from Longtan revealed the climate and environment would have been similar in southwestern China to that of Europe. However, the authors found no animal remains at the site, so it’s not known whether the humans who lived there hunted similar animals, they said.
The excavators unearthed hundreds of stone tools from the site during digs in 2019 and 2020. Study coauthor Davide Delpiano (third from right) of the University of Ferrara is seen with members of the research team.
Qi-Jun Ruan/Hao Li
“The Quina package represents an adaptation to highly developed mobility strategies: these artifacts were designed to last a long time, as nomadic human groups were forced to search for resources that, due to increasingly harsh climatic conditions, were becoming scarcer,” Delpiano said.
It was possible Neanderthals made it as far east as southwest China, or perhaps they encountered other human species in their home territory, an interaction that allowed their stone tool technology to spread eastward, he said.

data.title: The demoscene as a UNESCO heritage in Sweden
data.author: robin_reala
data.article_summary: 2025年，瑞典的demoscene被列入联合国教科文组织国家遗产名录，这是由Ziphoid和作者去年提交的申请促成的。作为“编程艺术”国际计划的一部分，demoscene正在争取成为全球遗产。该场景是世界上最古老的数字亚文化之一，尽管技术不断发展，它仍保持自己的价值观和传统。demoscene的核心是利用特定硬件进行创作竞争，但并非所有人都遵循这一规则。例如作者的团队Hack n' Trade更喜欢制作另类作品。demoscene具有多样性，有些人专注于制作，有些人则通过组织活动或保存软件来维持场景活力。对作者而言，demoscene不仅是一个国际现象，更是与朋友共同创造“无目的的奇特电脑作品”的乐趣所在。这种保守与开放并存的特性，使其有理由被视为无形文化遗产。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：瑞典 demoscene 被列入联合国教科文组织遗产名录引发的多角度讨论

不同观点：
• [支持与赞赏] chaosprint 认为这是对数字文化及其遗产的重要认可，并从中受到启发，反思挪威在支持数字艺术方面的路径。他也提到在挪威，公共艺术资金对新兴数字艺术形式的支持可能较为有限。
• [学术研究的需求] bane 作为90年代起参与 demoscene 的人，对这一认可感到兴奋，但更希望看到对 demoscene 在艺术、科技和人类学交汇处的研究增加。他指出，虽然场景内部有大量文献，但外部观察可以提供新的视角。
• [全球化与国家界限] skrebbel 认为，联合国教科文组织的国家界限划分不适合互联网时代的全球文化。demoscene 已经在芬兰和德国获得认可，继续按国家区分显得不合适。
• [个人回忆与情感] Kolorabi 和 karteum 分享了对过去 demoscene 活动和作品的个人回忆，表达了对该文化的深厚情感。
• [技术与艺术的结合] barcoder 强调 demoscene 的艺术风格和技术成就，指出这种形式与传统艺术有相似之处。
• [反对意见] huseyinkilic 认为 demoscene 不需要外部的认可。

补充讨论：
• [技术细节与工具] 讨论中提到了具体的 demoscene 作品和技术工具，如 Glicol、FastTracker 和 SecondReality，展示了参与者对技术细节的关注。
• [对教科文组织认可的困惑] jolmg 和 ChrisArchitect 对联合国教科文组织的认可标准感到困惑，质疑其是否仅适用于物理地点或是否对数字文化同样适用。
• [幽默与非正式评论] initramfs 和 tobr 的评论带有幽默性质，initramfs 以玩笑方式表达对讨论主题的非正式看法，tobr 则分享了对特定音乐作品的个人喜好。

争议焦点：
• 联合国教科文组织遗产名录的国家界限是否适用于全球化的数字文化，如 demoscene，是讨论中的一个主要争议点。
• 对于 demoscene 是否需要外部认可，存在不同看法，有人认为这是重要 validation，也有人认为不需要。

43533362.article_content:
The demoscene as a UNESCO heritage in Sweden
Mar 31, 2025
|
ramblings
The demoscene has become
a national UNESCO-heritage in Sweden
, thanks to an application that
Ziphoid
and me did last year. This has already happened in several European countries, as part of the international
Art of Coding
initiative to make the demoscene a global UNESCO heritage. I think this makes plenty of sense, since the demoscene is arguably the oldest creative digital subculture around. It has largely stuck to its own values and traditions throughout the world’s technological and economical shifts, and that sort of consistency is quite unusual in the digital world.
The main idea of the demoscene is to compete with productions that maximize a certain hardware, but that’s not what all demosceners like to do. My demogroup
Hack n’ Trade
for example, cares more about making weird stuff, and there are plenty of other groups like that. Some demosceners don’t release anything at all, but might do important work to keep the scene alive (BBS-trading, organizing parties, preserving software…).
I’ve written plenty of
papers
and
blog posts
about the demoscene, and I’ve often felt a gap between the stuff I write as a researcher and my personal experience of the demoscene. There is certainly an international demoscene with big events and huge releases that can be described in general terms, but what has mattered more to me is the local scenes, the small parties and the people you hang out with. Meeting up with a bunch of friends and making weird computer stuff “for no reason, really” is a great setting. That’s what I enjoy the most, in the end. For other sceners, it’s different.
There is a sort of diversity in the scene that is difficult to capture and generalize. The Swedish coder with a well-paid programming job and a busy family life might consider the demoscene as an escape to his teenage years, while the LSD-munching raver from France who trades illegal warez on BBSs and makes weird pixel art considers the scene as a free culture without corporate or art world bullshit. There’s room for both in the scene, because it is werdly conservative and open at the same time. And perhaps that is one of the reasons why it should be considered an intangible heritage.

data.title: Compiler Options Hardening Guide for C and C++
data.author: pjmlp
data.article_summary:
这篇文章是OpenSSF最佳实践工作组发布的C/C++编译器选项加固指南，旨在通过配置编译器和链接器选项，增强C/C++代码的安全性和可靠性，防止潜在攻击和异常行为。加固选项还能与现代操作系统的安全功能集成，并在开发过程中提供编译器警告、静态分析和调试工具等好处。

指南推荐了适用于GCC和Clang/LLVM的编译选项，如`-O2`、`-Wall`、`-Wformat`、`-Werror`、`-fstack-protector-strong`、`-z relro`等，用于检测漏洞和启用运行时保护机制。此外，根据不同情况（如可执行文件、共享库、多线程代码等），还需添加额外选项。

开发者应在开发过程中将警告视为错误（`-Werror`），但分发源码时应避免使用，以免依赖特定工具链。生产代码应尽可能加固以保证安全和性能，而测试代码应使用加固和调试选项以提高缺陷检测能力。

指南还强调逐步修改现有代码以兼容这些选项，并确保自动化测试通过。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：GCC编译器选项及其安全性和优化

不同观点：
• [mid-kid] 认为许多安全和优化的编译选项已经在GCC的各种发行版中默认启用，例如通过补丁或配置标志嵌入。他以Gentoo为例，列举了多个默认启用的选项，并提供了Arch Linux、Alpine Linux和Debian的默认编译器标志作为参考。
• [fuhsnn] 补充了一个重要的编译器选项 `-fzero-init-padding-bits=all`，指出该选项在GCC 15中对union初始化的重要性，并提供了一个示例链接以供参考。
• [derriz] 指出C++代码库中维护大量的编译器和链接器选项是一个挑战，特别是在不同版本的编译器和链接器之间进行回归测试时。他强调了C++在这方面的复杂性。
• [vkaku] 认为记住这些复杂的选项是不现实的，建议编译器开发者重新审视选项矩阵，提供易于记忆的默认选项，例如 `-O2`，并指出这在过去已经成功实现。

补充讨论：
• [stabbles] 讨论了动态加载器在处理 `$ORIGIN` 和符号链接时的一个潜在安全问题，并解释了其合理性和当前实现的必要性。
• [grandempire] 质疑将“所有开发者都会犯错”作为威胁模型的有效性，提出需要明确攻击者可能的具体行为和攻击目标。
• [dailykoder] 认为掌握GCC编译器选项比掌握C++未定义行为更难，呼应了 [vkaku] 的观点。
• [javier_e06] 分享了一次由于编译选项中多余空格导致构建失败的经验，并提到使用 `#pragma GCC diagnostic ignore` 来忽略特定警告的实用性。

其他相关讨论：
• [dapperdrake] 提供了多个进一步阅读的链接，包括Fabien Sanglard的文章和关于链接器的讨论，以及关于编译器选项的其他资源。
• [MITSardine] 提出对于简单的C++项目是否可能被用于恶意用途的疑问。
• [klysm] 建议引入一个版本控制机制，使开发者能够默认获得安全性并选择性能权衡。
• [tuananh] 提到Wolfi OS采用了OpenSSF编译器选项，提供了一个具体操作系统的实例。

争议焦点：
• 编译器选项的复杂性和维护难度，特别是在C++项目中的应用与回归测试挑战。
• 默认编译器选项的安全性和易用性之间的平衡。

43533516.article_content:
Compiler Options Hardening Guide for C and C++
by the
Open Source Security Foundation (OpenSSF)
Best Practices Working Group
, 2025-03-28
This document is a guide for compiler and linker options that contribute to delivering reliable and secure code using native (or cross) toolchains for C and C++. The objective of compiler options hardening is to produce application binaries (executables) with security mechanisms against potential attacks and/or misbehavior.
Hardened compiler options should also produce applications that integrate well with existing platform security features in modern operating systems (OSs). Effectively configuring the compiler options also has several benefits during development such as enhanced compiler warnings, static analysis, and debug instrumentation.
This document is intended for:
Those who write C or C++ code, to help them ensure that resulting code will work with hardened options, including for embedded devices, Internet of Things devices, smartphones, and personal computers.
Those who build C or C++ code for use in production environments, including Linux distributions, device makers, and those who compile C or C++ for their local environment.
This document focuses on recommended options for the GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) and Clang/LLVM, and we expect the recommendations to be applicable to other compilers based on GCC and Clang technology
1
. In the future, we aim to expand to guide to also cover other compilers, such as Microsoft MSVC.
TL;DR: What compiler options should I use?
When compiling C or C++ code on compilers such as GCC and clang, turn on these flags in all cases for detecting vulnerabilities at compile time and enable run-time protection mechanisms:
-O2
-Wall
-Wformat

-Werror

\
-U_FORTIFY_SOURCE

\
-fstrict-flex-arrays

-fstack-clash-protection
-fstack-protector-strong
\
-Wl
,-z,nodlopen
-Wl

In addition

add

for production code

Note that support for some options may differ between different compilers, e.g. support for
-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE
varies depending on the compiler
2
and C standard library implementations. See the discussion below for
background
and for
detailed discussion of each option
.
We recommend developers to additionally use a blanket
-Werror
to treat all warnings as errors during development. However,
-Werror
should
not
be used in this blanket form when
distributing
source code, as this use of
-Werror
creates a dependency on specific toolchain vendors and versions. The selective form
-Werror=
<warning-flag>
that promotes specific warnings as error in cases that should never occur in the code can be used both during development and when distributing sources. For example, we encourage developers to promote warnings regarding obsolete C constructs removed by the 1999 C standard to errors (see the “for disabling obsolete C constructs” in the above table). These options often cannot be added by those who independently build the software, because the options may require non-trivial changes to the source code.
In this guide, we use the term
production code
for executable code intended for use in the real world with real effects; it should be maximally reliable and performant. We use the term
instrumented test code
for executable code that is instrumented to improve defect detection and debuggability, and as such, often crashes more and is slower. Test processes should use both instrumented test code and production code.
Developers should ensure that both their production code and their instrumented test code pass their automated test suite with all their relevant options. We encourage developers to consider it a bug if the program cannot be compiled with these options. Those who build production code may choose to omit some hardening options that hurt performance if the program only processes trusted data, but remember that it’s not helpful to deploy programs that that are insecure and rapidly do the wrong thing. Existing programs may need to be modified over time to work with some of these options.

这篇文章是OpenSSF最佳实践工作组发布的C/C++编译器选项加固指南，旨在通过配置编译器和链接器选项，增强C/C++代码的安全性和可靠性，防止潜在攻击和异常行为。加固选项还能与现代操作系统的安全功能集成，并在开发过程中提供编译器警告、静态分析和调试工具等好处。

指南推荐了适用于GCC和Clang/LLVM的编译选项，如`-O2`、`-Wall`、`-Wformat`、`-Werror`、`-fstack-protector-strong`、`-z relro`等，用于检测漏洞和启用运行时保护机制。此外，根据不同情况（如可执行文件、共享库、多线程代码等），还需添加额外选项。

开发者应在开发过程中将警告视为错误（`-Werror`），但分发源码时应避免使用，以免依赖特定工具链。生产代码应尽可能加固以保证安全和性能，而测试代码应使用加固和调试选项以提高缺陷检测能力。

指南还强调逐步修改现有代码以兼容这些选项，并确保自动化测试通过。
43533516.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：GCC编译器选项及其安全性和优化

不同观点：
• [mid-kid] 认为许多安全和优化的编译选项已经在GCC的各种发行版中默认启用，例如通过补丁或配置标志嵌入。他以Gentoo为例，列举了多个默认启用的选项，并提供了Arch Linux、Alpine Linux和Debian的默认编译器标志作为参考。
• [fuhsnn] 补充了一个重要的编译器选项 `-fzero-init-padding-bits=all`，指出该选项在GCC 15中对union初始化的重要性，并提供了一个示例链接以供参考。
• [derriz] 指出C++代码库中维护大量的编译器和链接器选项是一个挑战，特别是在不同版本的编译器和链接器之间进行回归测试时。他强调了C++在这方面的复杂性。
• [vkaku] 认为记住这些复杂的选项是不现实的，建议编译器开发者重新审视选项矩阵，提供易于记忆的默认选项，例如 `-O2`，并指出这在过去已经成功实现。

补充讨论：
• [stabbles] 讨论了动态加载器在处理 `$ORIGIN` 和符号链接时的一个潜在安全问题，并解释了其合理性和当前实现的必要性。
• [grandempire] 质疑将“所有开发者都会犯错”作为威胁模型的有效性，提出需要明确攻击者可能的具体行为和攻击目标。
• [dailykoder] 认为掌握GCC编译器选项比掌握C++未定义行为更难，呼应了 [vkaku] 的观点。
• [javier_e06] 分享了一次由于编译选项中多余空格导致构建失败的经验，并提到使用 `#pragma GCC diagnostic ignore` 来忽略特定警告的实用性。

其他相关讨论：
• [dapperdrake] 提供了多个进一步阅读的链接，包括Fabien Sanglard的文章和关于链接器的讨论，以及关于编译器选项的其他资源。
• [MITSardine] 提出对于简单的C++项目是否可能被用于恶意用途的疑问。
• [klysm] 建议引入一个版本控制机制，使开发者能够默认获得安全性并选择性能权衡。
• [tuananh] 提到Wolfi OS采用了OpenSSF编译器选项，提供了一个具体操作系统的实例。

争议焦点：
• 编译器选项的复杂性和维护难度，特别是在C++项目中的应用与回归测试挑战。
• 默认编译器选项的安全性和易用性之间的平衡。

data.title: Show HN: I made a little puzzle game about a rogue chess knight
data.author: freetonik
data.article_summary: 《Knight Ride》是一款国际象棋主题的游戏，目标是让骑士在限定步数内到达目标格子。玩家通过快速到达、避免进入被攻击的格子、以及在途中捕获棋子来获得积分。每个被捕获的棋子根据类型提供不同的积分（如兵1分，骑士或象3分，车5分，皇后9分），并奖励额外步数。连续捕获两个或更多棋子可获得连击 bonus。完成关卡后，根据剩余步数和捕获情况计算关卡得分。如果步数用完则游戏结束，最终根据总得分评定高分。游戏由Rakhim D.制作。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一款基于骑士移动的象棋变体游戏的规则、机制和用户体验

不同观点：
• [gjm11] 认为游戏的说明不够详细，尤其是在得分和奖励机制方面。他建议增加更多说明，比如捕获不同棋子获得的分数和奖励移动次数，并提出了一种更清晰的规则描述方式。他还提到可能存在"连击"机制，但未深入了解。
• [dylan604] 分享了自己为儿童象棋俱乐部制作类似游戏的经历，并认为这款游戏非常适合用于教学，因为它不强调完整的象棋策略，而是通过游戏方式教导棋子的移动规则。
• [parsimo2010] 喜欢游戏的多样性玩法，包括不同层次的目标（仅过关、不失分过关、完美过关），认为这使得游戏适合不同层次的玩家，从休闲玩家到严肃玩家。
• [CaesarA] 认为游戏很有趣，并将其与Tetris发明者设计的另一款游戏相比较，但没有记住具体名称。
• [nomilk] 享受游戏的渐进难度和一些棋子作为提示的功能，但建议在被攻击时不只是扣分，而是直接失败重启，并提出更严厉的惩罚机制。
• [Lerc] 建议展示每个关卡的最佳可能得分，并引入更强的惩罚机制，比如损失移动次数，而不是仅仅扣分。

补充讨论：
• [Eric_WVGG] 指出游戏与Alexei Pajitnov的另一款游戏相似，并提供了相关链接。
• [freetonik] 分享了制作游戏的博客文章链接。
• [yubiox] 询问关卡是手动设计还是自动生成。
• [ffsm8] 对敌方棋子的颜色设计提出疑问，认为应该更明显地区分可捕获棋子。
• [tobyhinloopen] 和 [snarf21] 表示对游戏规则感到困惑，希望能有一个帮助屏幕或规则说明。
• [bobbiechen] 提到一个潜在的bug，在特定操作下可以无限获取分数，并提供了具体描述。
• [berbec] 希望游戏能保存进度，而不是每次重新开始。
• [sionisrecur] 认为游戏应该不允许移动到被攻击的位置，并建议增加规则说明。

争议焦点：
• 游戏规则的清晰度：一些玩家认为规则说明不够详细，导致困惑。
• 惩罚机制的严厉程度：有玩家建议在被攻击时应有更强的惩罚，比如直接失败重启，而不仅仅是扣分。
• 关卡设计的透明度：有玩家好奇关卡是手动设计还是自动生成。

总结：玩家们对游戏的创新性和趣味性普遍持肯定态度，但对规则说明的清晰度、惩罚机制的严厉程度以及可能的bug存在不同看法。改进建议主要集中在规则说明和游戏机制的调整上。

43515622.article_content:
Knight Ride
Get your knight to the target square.
Earn points for getting there quickly without being attacked, and capturing pieces on the way.
Level score = Points × Remaining Moves
Full rules
Complete each level by reaching the target within the given number of moves.
Each piece you capture gives you +1 move, and points based on the piece
(Pawn: 1 point. Knight or Bishop: 3. Rook: 5. Queen: 9.)
Capture 2 or more pieces in a streak to get bonus points (bonus is the length of the streak).
Lose 1 point when you move to an attacked square.
Double your points when you capture all the pieces.
Out of moves? Game over!

data.title: Open source, 3D-printable smart chess board
data.author: bdcravens
data.article_summary: OpenChess是一款开源的智能国际象棋棋盘，旨在通过低成本电子元件、3D打印和可定制软件，让制造者、教育者和象棋爱好者能够自行打造互联的象棋体验。其特点包括价格实惠、DIY友好、可编程以及模块化和开放性。所需材料包括OpenChess PCB、Arduino控制器和3D打印的棋盘及棋子。该项目适合课堂使用、自定义规则游戏设计或作为周末项目，将创造的权力交到用户手中。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI生成图片的质量与使用、棋盘设计与技术实现、PCB设计与制造过程

不同观点：
• **关于AI生成图片的质量与使用**：
  ◦ [ajw287] 指出第一张图片是AI生成的，存在明显缺陷，例如后排全部变白，第二排几乎消失。认为虽然生成图片比实际拍摄方便，但不应因此牺牲质量。
  ◦ [MS27] 引用文章评论，表达对AI生成图片的反感，认为不应使用这种图片来宣传作品。

• **关于棋盘设计与技术实现**：
  ◦ [throwaway81523] 认为棋盘和棋子尺寸不符合比赛标准，建议棋盘方块应为约2.25英寸，王的高度应为约3.75英寸。同时提出可以使用视频和软件识别棋步，减少对物理传感器的依赖。
  ◦ [throwaway81523] 还提到DGT的传感器棋盘，成本约600美元，指出磁传感器技术在1990年代已获专利，但现在专利应该已经过期。

• **关于PCB设计与制造过程**：
  ◦ [_factor] 质疑为何使用单块PCB，而不是使用3D打印槽和独立部件，认为这样可以更灵活地调整棋盘尺寸。
  ◦ [axegon_] 分享了对PCB设计、制造和运输过程的挫败感，希望这一过程能像3D打印和激光切割一样在未来变得更加民主化。

补充讨论：
• [gorbachev] 提供了PCB相关资源的链接，为对PCB设计感兴趣的人提供了参考。

争议焦点：
• AI生成图片的质量和适用性：部分评论者认为AI生成图片质量不高，不适合用于宣传。
• 棋盘设计的标准和实现方式：关于棋盘和棋子的尺寸标准以及是否依赖物理传感器存在不同看法。
• PCB设计的灵活性和制造过程的复杂性：讨论了使用单块PCB与独立部件和3D打印槽的优缺点，以及PCB设计制造过程的民主化需求。

OpenChess is a fully open source smart chessboard designed to make interactive, intelligent gameplay accessible to everyone. By combining low-cost electronics, 3D printing, and customizable software, OpenChess empowers makers, educators, and chess lovers to build their own connected chess experience — without the high price tag.
💡 Why OpenChess?
Most smart chessboards are expensive and closed-source. OpenChess changes that. It’s built from the ground up to be:
Affordable – Uses a custom PCB with embedded magnetic sensors and LEDs for real-time move detection and feedback.
DIY-Friendly – Print your own board, your own pieces, and assemble everything at home.
Programmable – Based on Arduino, you can customize behavior, create new game modes, or build learning tools and challenges.
Modular & Open – Everything is open source. Remix the board, design your own pieces, or upgrade the electronics however you want.

OpenChess PCB – Detects pieces and lights up squares.

data.article_summary: Confetti是一种配置语言，结合了Unix配置文件的可读性和S表达式的灵活性。它具有简约、无类型和主观性的特点，模式 conformance 由用户应用程序验证。Confetti不与JSON或XML竞争，而是与INI竞争。它支持自定义关键词、本地化友好，并鼓励扩展。与YAML的复杂性相比，Confetti的规范简单易学。其主要特点包括无类型设计、支持多语言配置文件、以及允许创建独特的语言变体。相比INI，Confetti支持层次结构和注释；相比JSON和TOML，Confetti更加本地化友好且不强制使用特定的布尔值和数字格式。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕新配置语言 Confetti 的设计、功能和优缺点的讨论

不同观点：
• EdgeExplorer 认为 Confetti 在处理 maps、trees 和非嵌套列表方面表现优异，但在处理嵌套列表和表格时相对笨拙。他建议在文档页面增加一个解析器来展示解析树，并转换为 JSON 或其他格式，以便用户进行实验。
• IshKebab 认为 Confetti 与 JSON 竞争，但个人更倾向于使用 JSON5。他指出，尽管 Confetti 设计优雅，优于 YAML 和 TOML，但无类型设计在某些方面可能是不好的决策。
• unwind 指出文档中关于 "opinionated" 和 "unopinionated" 的描述自相矛盾，造成了困惑。
• h1fra 对 Confetti 没有强制要求字符串加引号表示不信任，认为这是一个潜在的问题，尤其是在处理布尔值时。
• mncharity 提到当前缺乏对各种配置语言的全面比较，并质疑是否存在对设计空间的深入分析。
• Aachen 喜欢 Confetti 的设计，但认为规格说明可以更直观，尤其是对特殊符号（如 ${ENV:ANONPASS}）的解释需要更清晰。他还提到列表中使用反斜杠作为行尾标记的设计不如使用方括号直观。
• chrismorgan 对规格说明中关于控制字符和换行处理的描述提出质疑，认为需要更明确的规范以避免不同实现之间的不兼容问题。
• Myrmornis 调侃 Confetti 既被描述为 "opinionated" 又被描述为 "unopinionated"，认为这实际上意味着它 "unopinionated"。
• NuSkooler 表示仍然喜欢 HJSON 和 JSON5，但也认可 Confetti 的设计。
• ryukoposting 喜欢 Confetti 的无类型设计，并认为配置文件本质上是应用特定的，因此缺乏规格说明并不是问题。
• alpaca128 认为 Confetti 类似于 KDL，支持减少语法开销，尤其是在 JSON 语法负担较重的情况下。
• xnorswap 认为 XML 已经存在超过20年，并且仍然是一个功能齐全的配置格式，具备无歧义、有类型、可快速解析、支持模式验证和广泛工具支持等优点。
• juliangmp 不理解为什么 true、false 和 null 等关键词被视为负面设计，并指出数字系统是世界上大多数人使用的标准。
• M95D 对 "Material Definitions" 示例中没有使用 {} 以及缩进是否具有语法意义表示困惑。

补充讨论：
• 关于 Confetti 是否应强制使用引号以及如何处理环境变量（如 ${ENV:ANONPASS}）的问题存在一定争议。
• 规格说明中的自相矛盾和控制字符处理的模糊描述引发了对文档清晰度和一致性的关注。
• 对配置语言的全面比较和设计空间的深入分析存在需求，反映出当前配置语言多样性和复杂性带来的挑战。

争议焦点：
• Confetti 是否在处理嵌套数据结构和表格时表现笨拙。
• 文档中对 "opinionated" 和 "unopinionated" 的描述自相矛盾。
• 是否应强制使用引号以及如何处理环境变量。
• 规格说明中控制字符和换行处理的模糊描述。

43534240.article_content:
Introducing Confetti
Confetti is a
configuration language
that blends the readability of Unix configuration files with the flexibility of S-expressions.
It is minimalistic, untyped, and opinionated.
Schema conformance is validated by the user application.
Confetti does not compete with JSON or XML, it competes with INI.
Kitchen Sink Example
#
The following example uses most features of Confetti:
# This is a comment.
probe-device
eth0 eth1
user
* {
login
anonymous
password
"${ENV:ANONPASS}"
machine
167.89.14.1
proxy
{
try-ports
582 583 584
}
}
user
"Joe Williams"
{
login
joe
machine
167.89.14.1
}
Implementations
#
The canonical implementation of Confetti is written in C11 and is available on GitHub.
If you would like to create your own implementation of Confetti, then review the
specification
and test your implementation against the
official conformance test suite
.
Philosophy
#
Simplicity and minimalism is at the heart of Confetti.
Some formats, like YAML, are
very
complicated (look at the size of
its specification!
) whereas Confetti’s spec is simple and minimal, and it can be
learned in minutes
.
Confetti is
typeless
by design and its syntax is composable.
Confetti provides the atoms necessary to create everything from simple configuration, to textual file formats, to lightweight scripting.
Check out the
various examples
for inspiration.
Notable features:
Unopinionated
: Confetti lets you define custom keywords, like
on
and
off
, and tristates, like
yes
,
no
, and
maybe
.
This is in contrast to formats, like TOML, which mandate the keywords
true
and
false
.
Localization Friendly
: Confetti lets you write configuration files in your native language.
This is in contrast to formats, like JSON, which requires the English words
null
,
true
, and
false
, and Western digits
0
through
9
.
Extensions Encouraged
: Much like how Markdown has different flavors, you are encouraged to create unique flavors of Confetti.
The specification defines the common language and its annex includes extensions that are compatible with the grammar.
Feature Comparison
#
Here’s how Confetti compares to popular formats:
Confetti
INI
JSON
TOML
Specification
Typeless
Localization Friendly

Unicode Literals
1
Multiline Literals
Comments
Hierarchical Structures
Intended Use Case

Data Interchange
Configuration

INI has no specification and therefore support for internalization and Unicode are implementation dependent.
2

true
and

and Western digits

.

data.title: Scientists uncover key mechanism in evolution: Whole-genome duplication drives
data.author: docmechanic
data.article_summary: 科学家在探索生物如何向多细胞性转变的过程中，意外发现了全基因组 duplication (WGD) 在进化中的关键作用。由乔治亚理工学院的William Ratcliff教授及其团队主导的研究，通过长达数千代的实验室进化实验（MuLTEE），使用“雪花”酵母（*Saccharomyces cerevisiae*）观察到WGD在早期发生并持续存在，使酵母细胞长得更大、形成更大的多细胞簇，从而获得生存优势。尽管WGD通常不稳定，但在MuLTEE中因其适应性优势得以持久存在，并推动了多细胞性的进化。该研究揭示了WGD如何推动长期进化适应，并提供了对进化创新机制的新见解。研究还强调了本科生研究在突破性发现中的重要贡献。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：自我复制程序或生物体在退化环境中如何保持源代码或基因稳定性

不同观点：
• [evrimoztamur] 认为，任何在逐渐退化环境中的自我复制程序都应该记住其“源代码”。这种记住源代码的属性在早期出现是有道理的，有助于维持程序的稳定性。

• [yarnover] 指出，这种现象在植物中反复出现，暗示生物体在自然界中也存在类似的机制，能够应对环境退化并保持基因信息的稳定性。

• [docmechanic] 补充了科学研究中的实例，提到科学家已经揭示了全基因组复制如何在实验室中的数千代进化过程中保持稳定。这提供了具体的科学依据，支持了自我复制系统在退化环境中保持稳定性的可能性。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中提到了不同领域（计算机程序和生物体）中类似的自我复制和稳定性维持现象，表明这是一种跨学科的普遍现象。

• 争议的焦点可能在于“记住源代码”这一比喻在生物系统中的具体实现方式，以及这种机制在不同环境和系统中的普遍性。

• 科学实例的引入增强了对稳定性机制的理解，并为讨论提供了实证支持。

43515443.article_content:
Science News
from research organizations
Scientists uncover key mechanism in evolution: Whole-genome duplication drives long-term adaptation
While the researchers initially set out to explore how organisms transition to multicellularity, they discovered something else entirely
Date:
March 26, 2025
Source:
Georgia Institute of Technology
Summary:
Scientists uncovered how whole-genome duplication emerges and remains stable over thousands of generations of evolution in the lab.
Share:
Facebook
Twitter
Pinterest
LinkedIN
Email
FULL STORY
Sometimes, the most significant scientific discoveries happen by accident.
Scientists have long known that whole-genome duplication (WGD) -- the process by which organisms copy all their genetic material -- plays an important role in evolution. But understanding just how WGD arises, persists, and drives adaptation has remained poorly understood.
In an unexpected turn, scientists at Georgia Tech not only uncovered how WGD occurs, but also how it stays stable over thousands of generations of evolution in the lab.
The new study was led by William Ratcliff, professor in the School of Biological Sciences, and Kai Tong, a former Ph.D. student in Ratcliff's lab who is now a postdoctoral fellow at Boston University.
Their paper, "Genome duplication in a long-term multicellularity evolution experiment,"was published in
Nature
as the journal's cover story in March.
"We set out to explore how organisms make the transition to multicellularity, but discovering the role of WGD in this process was completely serendipitous," said Ratcliff. "This research provides new insights into how WGD can emerge, persist over long periods, and fuel evolutionary innovation. That's truly exciting."
A secret hidden in the data
In 2018, Ratcliff's lab launched an experiment to explore open-ended multicellular evolution. The Multicellular Long-Term Evolution Experiment (MuLTEE) uses "snowflake" yeast (
Saccharomyces cerevisiae
) as a medium, evolving it from a single cell to increasingly complex multicellular organisms. The researchers do this by selecting yeast cells for larger size on a daily basis.
"These long-term evolution studies help us answer big questions about how organisms adapt and evolve," said Tong. "They often reveal the unexpected and expand our understanding of evolutionary processes."
That's exactly what happened when Ozan Bozdag, a research faculty member in Ratcliff's lab, noticed something unusual in the snowflake yeast. Bozdag observed the yeast when it was 1,000 days old and saw characteristics suggesting it might have gone from diploidy (having two sets of chromosomes) to tetraploidy (having four).
Decades of lab experiments show that tetraploidy is characteristically unstable, reverting back to diploidy within a few hundred generations. For this reason, Tong was skeptical that WGD had occurred and persisted for thousands of generations in the MuLTEE. If true, it would be the first time a WGD arose spontaneously and persisted in the lab.
After taking measurements of the evolved yeast, Tong found that they had duplicated their genomes very early -- within the first 50 days of the MuLTEE. Strikingly, these tetraploid genomes persisted for more than 1,000 days, continuing to thrive despite the usual instability of WGD in laboratory conditions.
The team discovered that WGD arose and stuck around because it gave the yeast an immediate advantage in growing larger, longer cells and forming bigger multicellular clusters, which are favored under the size selection in the MuLTEE.
Further experiments showed that while WGD in snowflake yeast is normally unstable, it persisted in the MuLTEE because the larger, multicellular clusters had a survival advantage. This stability allowed the yeast to undergo genetic changes, with aneuploidy (the condition of having an abnormal number of chromosomes) playing a key role in the development of multicellularity. As a result, MuLTEE became the longest-running polyploidy evolution experiment, offering new insights into how genome duplication contributes to biological complexity.
A MuLTEE-talented team
Ratcliff emphasized that rigorous undergraduate research played a critical role in their unexpected breakthrough. Four undergraduate students were integral to the success of the experiment, joining the research early in their education at Georgia Tech.
"This kind of authentic research experience is life-changing and career-altering for our students," Ratcliff said. "You can't get this level of learning in a classroom."
Vivian Cheng, who joined Ratcliff's lab as a first-year and graduated in 2022, took on the challenge of genetically engineering diploid and tetraploid yeast strains along with another student. Ratcliff and Tong ended up using these same strains as a major part of their analysis.

data.author: tipiirai
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了Nue框架，它通过推动HTML、CSS和JS等现代web标准达到极致，构建出比React/ShadCN按钮更轻量的应用。Nue集成了Rust计算引擎和事件溯源（Event Sourcing），能瞬时处理超过15万条数据，克服了JS版本在递归调用上的瓶颈。该框架在工具链上也表现卓越，提供超快的热模块替换（HMR）和构建速度，实现毫秒级的反馈循环。对于Rust、Go和JS开发者，Nue强调模型优先和模块化设计，简化测试和静态类型。对于设计和UX工程师，Nue通过现代CSS和简化系统帮助他们更好地掌控用户体验。Nue旨在解决现代web开发中的复杂性问题，重塑开发工具，恢复开发乐趣。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对新 web 框架 "Nue" 的不同看法及对现代 web 开发框架性能问题的讨论

不同观点：
• [fcpk] 认为现代 web 框架（如 React）导致了网页变得缓慢和臃肿，尤其是在首次加载时间上，开发者过度依赖这些框架而忽视了性能问题。他指出，即使是简单的页面也需要很长时间加载，主要时间花费在 JS 上。
• [davedx] 对 Nue 持怀疑态度，认为 Nue 没有类型支持，类似于早期的 Angular 2.0，并且其目标用户可能是 Vue.js 开发者，而非 React 用户。
• [wg0] 曾经转向 Svelte，但最终还是选择继续使用 React，理由是 React 成熟、生态系统庞大，且即将发布的 React 编译器能解决许多复杂场景的问题，性能也接近 Svelte。
• [codedokode] 希望看到更多技术细节，特别是 Nue 的变更追踪机制和其声称的 JS 堆栈溢出问题，认为现有示例不足以说明问题。
• [canterburry] 认为新框架往往以“轻量级”为卖点，但在经过多年发展和添加功能后，最终可能也会变得臃肿，因此对 Nue 的长期表现持怀疑态度。
• [edweis] 对 Nue 的性能和创新性提出质疑，认为需要更多的代码示例和性能对比数据才能让人信服，并指出 Nue 的设计可能受到了 Svelte 的启发。
• [greg0r] 认为 Nue 的宣传存在误导性，尤其是与 React 按钮的比较并不公平，因为 React 的库通常会在整个应用中共享。
• [leonhard] 报告了 Nue 框架的 demo 在 iOS Safari 上的兼容性问题，影响了用户体验。
• [n2d4] 希望能在新框架的介绍中首先看到代码示例，而不是其他内容。
• [h14h] 认为将网页的“沉重感”归咎于框架是过于简单化的看法，真正的性能问题更多地与开发者的优化能力和分布式系统问题的解决能力有关。
• [bryanhogan] 认为 React 被过度使用，建议根据项目需求选择更合适的框架（如 Astro、Svelte、Vue 等），而不是一味地使用 React。
• [austin-cheney] 强烈批评现代开发者过度依赖框架（如 React），导致缺乏基本的优化和编程能力，认为这是 web 变慢的根本原因。
• [aziaziazi] 对技术职位名称的变化感到困惑，并对求职时如何筛选合适的职位表示担忧。
• [vanderZwan] 对 Nue 声称的 JS 堆栈溢出问题持怀疑态度，认为通过 TypedArrays 等技术可以实现高效的 JS 操作，并且不认为 React 等同于 JS 的全部。

补充讨论：
• Nue 框架的定位和目标用户群体存在争议，部分用户认为其定位不清，尤其是与 Vue 和 React 的比较。
• 关于 web 性能问题的根本原因，讨论中存在两种主要观点：一是框架本身的臃肿问题，二是开发者对框架的依赖和优化能力的缺乏。
• 多个评论者要求提供更多技术细节和性能对比数据，以证明 Nue 的创新性和优越性。
• 兼容性和实际使用中的问题也被提出，如 Nue 在 iOS Safari 上的兼容性问题。

On this release, we’re showing what happens when you push modern web standards — HTML, CSS, and JS — to their peak:
This entire
app

than a React/ShadCN button:

here ›
Going large-scale
Here’s the same app, now with a
Rust

Event Sourcing
for instant search and other operations over
150,000
records — far past where
JS-version
of the engine choked on recursive calls over the records.
Instant operations across 150.000 records with Rust/WASM
This demo is
here ›
Tooling
Nue crushes HMR and build speed records and sets you up with a millisecond feedback loop for your everyday VSCode/Sublime file-save operations:
Immediate feedback for design and component updates, preserving app state
Here's what this means:
For Rust, Go, and JS engineers
This is a game-changer for Rust, Go, and JS engineers stuck wrestling with React idioms instead of leaning on timeless software patterns. Nue emphasizes a model-first approach, delivering modular design with simple, testable functions, true static typing, and minimal dependencies. Nue is a liberating experience for system devs whose skills can finally shine in a separated model layer.
For Design Engineers
This is an important shift for design engineers bogged down by React patterns and
40,000+ line
design systems. Build radically simpler systems with modern CSS (@layers, variables, calc()) and take control of your typography and whitespace.
For UX Engineers
This is a wake-up call for UX engineers tangled in React hooks and utility class walls instead of owning the user experience. Build apps as light as a React button to push the web — and your skills — forward.
FAQ: WTH is Nue?
Nue is a web framework focused on web standards, currently in active development. We aim to reveal the hidden complexity that’s become normalized in modern web development. When a single button outweighs an entire application, something’s fundamentally broken.
Nue drives the inevitable shift. We’re rebuilding tools and frameworks from the ground up with a cleaner, more robust architecture. Our goal is to restore the joy of web development for all key skill sets: frontend architects, design engineers, and UX engineers.

data.title: Show HN: Duolingo-style exercises but with real-world content like the news
data.author: ph4evers
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕语言学习工具的功能、用户体验（UX）、以及多语言支持的讨论

不同观点：
• **多语言支持的质量和成熟度**：
  - [gwd] 指出当前多语言支持存在优劣不一的问题，建议将语言设置为"alpha"状态，逐步根据社区反馈提升至"beta"或"1.0"版本。
  - [dicytea] 具体提到日语内容过于简单，且对话不自然，远离“真实世界内容”。同时，视频默认带有字幕，削弱了练习效果。

• **用户体验（UX）的改进建议**：
  - [hrydgard] 和 [rurp] 都提到当前的拖放式填空操作不便，尤其是非触屏设备上，建议改为点击填空以提高可访问性。
  - [whycome] 进一步提出多项具体UX改进建议，包括用词调整（“gaps”改为“blanks”）、避免拖放模块移动、显示用户选择的错误答案，以及在所有空格填完后再进行检查等。
  - [tom2948329494] 认为初始配置步骤令人困惑，特别是“Number of Gaps”选项和输入方式选择，建议让用户先以默认设置进入应用，再逐步探索功能。

• **功能扩展和个性化建议**：
  - [philipjoubert] 建议将西班牙语分为西班牙和拉丁美洲版本，增加难度级别，并允许用户选择视频主题。
  - [pajop] 表达了对模拟沉浸式学习工具的期待，如通过观看电影学习语言。
  - [bomewish] 表示愿意为更完善和专业的版本付费，特别提到德语学习。

• **具体语言练习中的问题**：
  - [hk__2] 提到在意大利语和法语练习中遇到单词缺失或显示无效的问题。
  - [sergiosgc] 建议在句子完成后提供英文翻译，以帮助学习新单词。
  - [Vinnl] 指出荷兰语练习中出现了较偏的地名，这对不熟悉荷兰的学习者来说过于困难，建议让LLM避免使用专有名词。
  - [Timpy] 提到日语练习中的视频播放起始时间稍晚，导致第一个单词被切掉，而在法语和西班牙语的练习中没有这个问题。

• **关于Duolingo的对比讨论**：
  - [iambateman] 提到Duolingo的免费模式给商业化带来了挑战，但认为当前工具的概念更具吸引力，如果能够连接娱乐内容，将有巨大潜力。
  - [rurp] 认为当前工具的UX优于Duolingo，Duolingo的初始体验包含过多营销问题，影响了用户体验。
  - [inetknght] 指出Duolingo在发音反馈和词典翻译方面存在不足，缺乏有效的改进建议机制。

补充讨论：
- 评论中多次提到Duolingo作为对比对象，显示出用户在评价新工具时会自然地与现有成熟产品进行比较。
- 用户对多语言支持的期望较高，但对不同语言的实际体验存在差异，表明语言资源的质量和本地化工作仍是关键挑战。
- 用户普遍对工具的潜力表示认可，并提出了许多具体改进建议，显示出较高的参与度和期望值。
